data.description:
## Description
**What**: The dso:task-decomposer emits a feature-flag rollout task only when the rollout:feature-flags-approved tag is present on the story or its parent epic (two-hop ticket-CLI lookup); otherwise it emits none and records the prohibition.
**Why**: Feature-flag work is gated by explicit governance; its absence is recorded with a reason rather than silently dropped or speculatively added.
**Scope**:
- IN: tag-gated emission of the flag-guarded cutover + flag-removal cleanup pair; prohibition recording on absence.
- OUT: sweep pairs; db rollback pairs; sprint scheduling order; capturing the approval tag during brainstorm (separate epic).

## Done Definitions
- When rollout:feature-flags-approved is present on the story or its parent epic (verified via a two-hop ticket-CLI lookup), task-decomposer emits a flag-guarded cutover task paired with a flag-removal cleanup task
  ← Satisfies: sc-4  (sc-4: tag-gated feature-flag emission)
- When the tag is absent on both the story and its parent (including when no parent exists), no feature-flag task is emitted and the plan header records feature_flags:prohibited with a reason
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The presence of feature-flag wording in the story text does not by itself trigger a feature-flag task when the approval tag is absent
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Shares the dso:task-decomposer emission surface with the sweep and db stories — add a flag-tag case to the single marker-class dispatch point; reserve the flag-cutover / flag-cleanup task-type namespaces.
- [Reliability] If the two-hop parent lookup fails or there is no parent, default to prohibited (safe default) and record the reason.

## Escalation Policy
**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a planner, I emit feature-flag rollout tasks only when approved by tag
